'''Kuan Murasaka''' is an acrobat and part of [[Valan Luca]]'s [[Valan Luca's Traveling Show|Traveling Show]]

==History==
She is one of six sisters who are traveling acrobats called "The Murasaka Sisters". Despite being called "sisters," they look nothing alike, and are not actually related.<ref name=comp>[[The Wheel of Time Companion]], Murasaka sisters.</ref>


==Activities==
She and her five "sisters", one of whom is [[Andaya Murasaka]], join Valan Luca's Traveling Show when Luca hires them away from [[Sillia Cerano]]'s show.
